judgement.reason: Mastodon's real-time timeline relies on a separate Node.js streaming API server on its own port alongside the Rails web server, which Deployz's single web process may not provide.

evidence.quote: **Real-time, chronological timeline updates** - updates of people you're following appear in real-time in the UI.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (web, streaming). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: Mastodon's streaming API is a separate Node.js service that the README describes as powering real-time updates, and no shown line proves production can run without it or that it fits the single web process.
